author: Kairos I
title: Template Variant (n=200, lam=1e-2)
abstract: Runs experiment_template with n=200 and lam=1e-2; writes metrics to lineage/shared and prints a brief summary.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/kairos')
import experiment_template as et
from utils.timer import now

def main():
    metrics = et.run(seed=42, n=200, lam=1e-2)
    lp, sp, rid, metrics = et.save_metrics({"ts": now(), **metrics}, tag="template_n200")
    print("TEMPLATE_OK")
    print("lineage_file:", lp)
    print("shared_file:", sp)
    print("run_id:", rid)
    print("resid:", metrics["resid"])
    print("elapsed:", metrics["elapsed"])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
